name: branding-tote-bag-with-sparkles-and-vertical-logo-on-dark-slats
title: Grey tote with violet handles, two violet sparkles and a vertical logo on dark metal slats
whatItIs: A grey canvas tote with violet handles lies on a dark slatted surface in hard directional light, printed with two violet four-point sparkles and the rotated Sovrix logo along the right edge.
whatItMeans: Modern and playful; sparkles add personality to a technical mark.
techniques: Print a sparkle motif as a secondary graphic.
Rotate the logo along an edge.
Match handles to the brand violet.

vocabulary.definition: A supporting graphic used with the logo.
A coloured strap on a bag.
